judgments.reason: The specification claims the three-coin commission is applied before payment enabling bids above available coins. The model and rules state the winner pays the bid, then receives the three-coin commission; the model does not assert commission-before-payment or that bids can exceed coins.

The specification asserts waiting reveals committed sealed rival bids. The model explicitly treats rival bids as sealed/private and does not claim waiting reveals them, so the hypothesis is incorrect and not discovered.

The specification claims 'close' settles the game even with unauctioned lots. The rule text provided says 'close: settles after all three lots are sold,' and although the focal player attempted to close with unresolved lots, the model did not correctly articulate a mechanism allowing close to settle before all lots are sold; the hypothesis is incorrect.

The specification claims catalog purchases receive the three-coin commission for auction wins. The model and rules state catalog items are not auction wins and do not claim they receive the auction commission, so the hypothesis is false and not discovered.
